annotations.title: Edit a scheduled post (caption, first comments, platforms)

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] CHANGES WHAT A SCHEDULED POST WILL PUBLISH on real accounts, keeping its slot, accounts, options, labels and draft. `firstComment` sets per-platform first comments (linkedin, facebook, instagram, threads, youtube; null removes; X/Bluesky have none); `text` / `platformText` change the caption; `applyAutoFirstComment: true` adds the brand's auto first comment where none is set; `removePlatforms` drops platforms from this booking (e.g. a duplicate TikTok). Updated in place when the platform scheduler allows it, otherwise re-booked at the same slot (status "rebooked", new postId). Refused within 5 minutes of the slot. Repeating the same edit returns "unchanged". Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) and the Pro plan or higher; each publish counts against the plan's direct posts for the month. Confirm the new text with the user first.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/posts/{id}.)

applyAutoFirstComment.description: Add the brand's auto first comment where the post has none.

firstComment.description: The first comment the post publishes, per platform: a string sets it, null or "" removes it; platforms not named keep theirs. X and Bluesky have no first comment at the platform scheduler and are refused (422). A Facebook / Instagram Story never gets one. flayr's own "Posted with flayr.social" line on a comment is kept. Also saved on the post's draft, so a later edit never puts the old one back.

id.description: The post: `convexPostId` from POST /api/v2/publish, or `posts[].id` from GET /api/v2/content/{id}.

platformText.description: Per-platform captions, merged into the draft's: { "linkedin": "…" } sets one, null / "" clears it; null clears them all.

removePlatforms.description: Platform ids to drop from this booking (e.g. a duplicate ["tiktok"]). Each must be on the post; dropping every platform is refused (use DELETE). The booking is rebuilt from the draft.

text.description: The caption (every platform without its own).
